conditions.guideline_ec: EC no. 440/2008 Part A, Guideline A.6 'Water Solubility', OJEU L142, 31 May 2008
conditions.guideline_oecd: OECD Guidelines for the Testing of Chemicals no. 105 'Water Solubility', 27 July 1995
